insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Personal waiting period up to 36 months possible for declared PED. 50% co-pay PED rider covers years 2-3 up to Rs.2L.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured per policy year
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Covers Medical Practitioner fees, diagnostics, medicines, OT, ICU, IV, blood, prosthetics.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: 3-day minimum continuous treatment when hospitalization not possible.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs.5,000 per hospitalization (includes app-based cab)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Covers Second Opinion for 22 Critical Illnesses; 4X Multiplier Benefit for Life Threatening Conditions
critical_illness_cover.notes: 22 CIs include: Cancer, MI, CABG, Heart Valve, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ Transplant, Paralysis, Motor Neuron, MS, Angioplasty, Benign Brain Tumor, Blindness, Deafness, End-Stage Lung/Liver Failure, Loss of Speech/Limbs, Head Trauma, Pulmonary Hypertension, Third Degree Burns.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Flexi Reload up to 100% of Base Sum Insured
restoration_benefit.notes: Once per policy year; available for same illness same insured; not for 1st claim.

copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-payment 5%/10%/15%/20% (with premium discount). 50% co-pay applies for PED rider years 2-3.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Emergency Domestic Evacuation up to Rs.1 lakh.

notable_exclusions_summary: Multiplier excludes maternity (Excl18), infertility (Excl17), OPD, refractive error, treatments outside India, and all standard IRDAI permanent exclusions. The 4X Multiplier Benefit triggers in Life Threatening Conditions and provides additional 4X SI+NCB cover, available 4 times in lifetime.
claim_process_summary: Claims settled via TPA. Cashless requires pre-authorization at Network Hospital. Reimbursement claims documented and settled within 15 days of last necessary document. Penal interest 2% above bank rate for delays.
